sources.fullCitation: ISNI International Agency. Registry record 0000 0000 7143 777X, name forms Włast; Włast, A.; Włast, Andrzej, dates 1895-1943?. Under related identities the record gives “Baumritter, Gustaw (other identity, same person)” and “Willy (other identity, same person)”. Contributing sources: VIAF, NUKAT, BnF. Accessed 1 August 2026. The birth year is contested across authority files: ISNI, the VIAF cluster and the Library of Congress record all give 1895, while the GND record 1203212704 gives a precise 17 March 1885 and Wikidata follows it. The archive keeps 1895, which carries three files against two and rests on the Polish union catalogue NUKAT among ISNI's contributing sources.
